bend-oregon-wedding-invitations.title: Bend Oregon Wedding Invitations | Templates & Guest Details
bend-oregon-wedding-invitations.description: Plan Bend and Central Oregon wedding invitations with clear venue wording, travel details, print checks and editable template options.
bend-oregon-wedding-invitations.intro: Give guests the information they need to celebrate in Central Oregon. Start with the exact ceremony location, then choose a design that suits your venue rather than trying to fit every mountain, pine tree and desert detail onto one card.
bend-oregon-wedding-invitations.decision: A template works when its existing illustration fits your plans. For artwork of your own Bend venue, ask about a custom request before buying.
bend-oregon-wedding-invitations.caption: Hand-sketched invitation from the current shop. The existing venue drawing is not a Bend venue illustration.

sections.heading: Make the Bend wedding location unambiguous
sections.body: A mailing address and a venue name do different jobs. Put the ceremony venue and city on the invitation; put the full address, arrival directions and any separate reception location on a details card or wedding website. For a destination celebration, avoid using “Bend” as a substitute for the actual town where guests should arrive.
bullets: Confirm whether the event is in Bend, Sunriver, Sisters, Redmond or another community.
Use the exact venue name guests will see on their booking or directions.
Distinguish ceremony time from the time you want guests to arrive.

sections.heading: Choose a Central Oregon invitation style
sections.body: A venue sketch can suit an architectural setting; a restrained type layout leaves room for practical information; a landscape illustration makes scenery the focus. A design does not need to reproduce every part of the destination to feel connected to the wedding. Keep the names, date and location easier to read than any decorative motif.
bullets: For a lodge or wooded setting, consider simple type paired with one illustrated feature.
For a modern indoor reception, let spacing and typography carry the style.
For an outdoor event, put surface, footwear or weather notes with the guest details.

sections.heading: Give visiting guests a useful details page
sections.body: Keep the main invitation focused on the ceremony. Your supporting information can answer how guests get there, where they should stay, whether there is a shuttle and which events require a separate RSVP. Verify every travel and venue detail with the people arranging the wedding before you publish it.
bullets: List a shuttle pickup location and time only after they are confirmed.
Label welcome events and farewell gatherings separately from the wedding.
Put updates on one wedding website so printed cards do not need to carry changing details.

sections.heading: Understand the template and printing scope
sections.body: The current hand-sketched invitation listing is an editable Canva design with the venue drawing shown in its photos. It is a digital purchase, not a package of printed cards or a custom portrait of your venue. Ask about any matching RSVP or details card as a separate request, and confirm the printer’s file requirements before exporting.
bullets: Check the live product page and Etsy listing for exactly what is included.
Proof the venue name, town, date and RSVP destination together.
Order a proof before committing to the full print quantity.

checklist: Confirm the actual city and ceremony address.
Add a separate reception address if needed.
Check guest travel and shuttle information.
Test the RSVP link on a phone.
Review a printed proof at the final card size.

faqs.q: Do you sell a template with a drawing of our Bend wedding venue?
faqs.a: The current hand-sketched template uses the venue drawing shown in its product photos. It is not a drawing of your specific Bend venue. Ask about custom artwork and confirm scope, price and timing first.

faqs.q: Can I use an editable wedding invitation template for a Bend wedding?
faqs.a: Yes, if the design fits your event. Personalize the wording and event details within the template’s editing options; check the product listing for what can be changed.

faqs.q: What should Central Oregon destination wedding invitations include?
faqs.a: Include names, the date, ceremony time, venue and actual city. Use a details card or wedding website for addresses, lodging, transport and separate weekend events.

faqs.q: Can I print digital wedding invitations in Bend?
faqs.a: You can arrange printing with a printer of your choice. Confirm size, bleed, paper and file requirements directly with that printer; the digital template does not include a printing service.

joshua-tree-wedding-invitations.title: Joshua Tree Wedding Invitations | Editable Desert Template
joshua-tree-wedding-invitations.description: Explore the hand-drawn Joshua Tree invitation template, desert wedding wording, editing limits and destination guest details before buying.
joshua-tree-wedding-invitations.intro: A hand-drawn desert illustration can set the tone without making the wording harder to read. See the current Joshua Tree template, understand what you can personalize, and plan the guest details that belong beside the invitation.
joshua-tree-wedding-invitations.decision: The live listing covers one invitation design. Save the dates, RSVP cards and other matching pieces need a separate request.
joshua-tree-wedding-invitations.caption: The current Joshua Tree wedding invitation template: existing desert artwork with editable event wording.

sections.heading: What the Joshua Tree invitation includes
sections.body: The current design pairs a hand-drawn desert illustration with editable wording in Canva. The product page lists one invitation design and a Canva Basics guide. Review the photos for the actual artwork and layout; treat additional stationery as a separate project rather than assuming the purchase is a full wedding suite.
bullets: Personalize names, date, ceremony location and other supported text fields.
Use the shown illustration; a new venue drawing is not part of this template purchase.
Check the Etsy listing for current purchase and delivery details.

sections.heading: Keep desert wedding wording practical
sections.body: A desert illustration tells guests about the atmosphere; the wording tells them where to go. Use the actual venue and city rather than a broad destination label if the ceremony is elsewhere. Describe an elopement celebration accurately so guests know whether they are attending the ceremony or a reception after it.
bullets: Separate the ceremony invitation from a post-elopement celebration.
State the reception location if it differs from the ceremony.
Keep attire, terrain and arrival instructions on the supporting details page.

sections.heading: Build a clear wedding weekend information page
sections.body: Destination guests may need lodging, transport and several event times. Keep that schedule separate from the invitation so it remains easy to update. If you are planning a park ceremony, confirm access and event arrangements with the relevant venue or authority before putting them in guest instructions.
bullets: Use one confirmed address or meeting point for each event.
Clarify which gatherings are optional and which need an RSVP.
Do not use “Joshua Tree National Park” as the venue unless it is the actual ceremony location.

sections.heading: Print a desert illustration without losing the detail
sections.body: The fine lines and background colors should be judged at the final printed size. After personalizing the design, check that every line of text has enough contrast. A screen preview cannot show exactly how your selected paper and printer will reproduce the illustration.
bullets: Check file size and export settings against the printer’s requirements.
Review a proof for legibility, crop and color.
Keep envelope and postage costs separate from the digital design purchase.

faqs.a: The template uses the existing illustration shown in its gallery. A different venue drawing requires a separate custom request.

san-diego-wedding-invitations.title: San Diego Wedding Invitations | Coastal Wording & Template Guide
san-diego-wedding-invitations.description: Plan San Diego wedding invitations with coastal style ideas, ceremony and reception wording, guest logistics and honest template options.
san-diego-wedding-invitations.intro: Waterfront, garden and city weddings need different guest information even when they share a coastal look. Use this guide to choose a template direction, organize your wording and decide when a custom venue illustration is worth requesting.
san-diego-wedding-invitations.decision: The current shop does not list a dedicated San Diego illustration. Browse the existing drawings carefully or discuss a custom design before purchase.
san-diego-wedding-invitations.caption: Current hand-sketched venue design, shown as an illustration-led option—not a San Diego venue portrait.

sections.heading: Match the invitation to the setting
sections.body: A coastal wedding invitation can use open space, readable type and a simple illustrated focal point without adding beach motifs everywhere. A garden ceremony may call for a softer treatment, while a city reception can suit a restrained layout. Choose the actual design you like; destination labels alone do not establish whether its artwork fits your venue.
bullets: For a waterfront setting, keep the location wording distinct from decorative elements.
For a garden event, keep fine lettering readable against illustration.
For a city reception, give the venue and event time a clear place in the layout.

sections.heading: Separate ceremony and reception directions
sections.body: If guests travel between locations, name both places and explain the transition on your details page. A broad “San Diego” label is not enough for arrival instructions. Use the actual city and venue address where appropriate, and confirm parking or transport information directly with your venue.
bullets: State “Reception to follow at [venue]” when the location changes.
Label guest arrival time separately from the ceremony time.
Put parking, transport and accessibility arrangements with the practical details.

sections.heading: Write for the event guests are attending
sections.body: A small ceremony followed by a larger party needs different wording from a full-day invitation. If some guests are invited only to the reception, make that explicit. For a destination weekend, provide a separate schedule rather than shrinking the main invitation text to fit every gathering.
bullets: Use reception-only wording when guests are not attending the ceremony.
Give each weekend event its own location and RSVP instructions.
Avoid promising a beach ceremony if the confirmed location is indoors or elsewhere.

sections.heading: Choose an existing template or a custom request
sections.body: The studio’s current hand-sketched invitation has an existing venue illustration. You can use its supported editing options for your event wording, but it should not be presented as a San Diego venue drawing. If a specific building or coastal scene matters, ask about custom artwork and confirm the deliverables before ordering.
bullets: Share a venue reference and the pieces you need in a custom request.
Confirm whether you need a single invitation or coordinating stationery.
Ask about file size, revision scope and timing; arrange printing separately.

faqs.q: Do you have a dedicated San Diego wedding invitation template?
faqs.a: The current shop does not list a dedicated San Diego venue illustration. Existing templates may work for your wording and style; browse their artwork or discuss a custom request.

faqs.q: Can a San Diego wedding invitation include two venues?
faqs.a: Yes. Name the ceremony venue and identify the separate reception venue. Use a details card or wedding website for full addresses and travel instructions.

faqs.q: What belongs on a coastal wedding details card?
faqs.a: Include confirmed arrival, parking or transport instructions, relevant attire notes and the RSVP destination. Keep information specific to your actual venue.

faqs.q: Can I order printed San Diego wedding stationery here?
faqs.a: The current shop products are digital templates. Arrange printing separately, and confirm any custom design request with the studio before purchasing.

boho-weddings.title: Boho Wedding Invitations | Desert Style & Canva Template Guide
boho-weddings.description: Choose boho wedding invitations with clear type, earthy color ideas and practical print checks. See the current desert template and its editing scope.
boho-weddings.intro: Choose one strong detail: a desert sketch, an earthy accent or a relaxed type pairing. A boho invitation works best when the style supports the information rather than competing with the names, date and place.
boho-weddings.decision: The Joshua Tree design is the current desert illustration option. Its artwork is fixed to the design shown; review the editing scope before buying.
boho-weddings.caption: Joshua Tree invitation from the current shop, used here as a desert boho design example.

sections.heading: Choose the kind of boho style you mean
sections.body: “Boho” can describe a desert illustration, botanical details, warm color or a handmade feel. Narrow it to one direction before choosing a template. If your venue is already visually rich, an uncluttered invitation can connect to that setting without repeating every floral or textile detail.
bullets: Desert direction: make the landscape sketch the main visual feature.
Earthy direction: keep the accent palette small and the wording high contrast.
Minimal direction: use generous spacing and a single illustration.

sections.heading: Make earthy colors readable
sections.body: Pale ink on a warm background can look softer on screen than it does in print. Put essential information in a color that remains readable at normal card size, and use lighter tones for supporting design details. If the template allows color changes, test your actual wording before deciding on the palette.
bullets: Read the address and RSVP line at the final size.
Limit decorative script to short text that remains clear.
Do not shrink body text to make room for a larger illustration.

sections.heading: Build a suite without assuming pieces are included
sections.body: An invitation, a save the date and a details card have separate jobs. Start with the pieces guests actually need and check whether the listing includes them. The current Joshua Tree listing covers one invitation design; coordinating pieces can be discussed as a separate custom request.
bullets: Invitation: names, date, time and location.
Details card or website: logistics, attire and weekend plans.
RSVP: response destination, deadline and any required guest choices.

sections.heading: Choose paper after you check the files
sections.body: Texture can complement the style, but fine lines and small text still need to reproduce clearly. Ask your printer which paper and export format suit your design. A sample proof lets you assess the illustration, color and readability together before placing the full order.
bullets: Confirm the design size before selecting envelopes.
Check the printer’s bleed and margin requirements.
Budget for printing, envelopes and postage separately from the template.

faqs.q: What makes a wedding invitation boho?
faqs.a: A boho invitation often uses an organic illustration, an earthy palette or relaxed typography. The style is flexible; choose a clear focal point and keep event details readable.

faqs.q: Do you sell a desert boho wedding invitation template?
faqs.a: The current Joshua Tree invitation uses a hand-drawn desert illustration with editable event wording in Canva. Its product page shows the artwork and included design.

faqs.q: Can I change every element in a boho Canva invitation?
faqs.a: Do not assume every element is editable. Review the listing and product guidance; the current desert template uses the existing illustration shown in its photos.

faqs.q: Does a boho invitation purchase include a full matching suite?
faqs.a: The current Joshua Tree purchase is one invitation design. Confirm any separate RSVP card, details card or signage request with the studio.

mountain-weddings.title: Mountain Wedding Invitations | Outdoor Wording & Design Guide
mountain-weddings.description: Plan mountain wedding invitations with landscape style ideas, lodge and outdoor guest details, destination wording and digital template guidance.
mountain-weddings.intro: Let the setting influence the design, then give guests clear information about the day. A mountain wedding invitation needs more than a scenic motif: the location, arrival instructions and outdoor plans should be easy to understand.
mountain-weddings.decision: The current shop does not list a dedicated alpine or forest template. Use an existing design only if its artwork fits, or discuss a custom illustration.
mountain-weddings.caption: Existing venue-sketch invitation from the shop. It is not an alpine landscape or custom lodge illustration.

sections.heading: Choose a landscape, lodge or type-led direction
sections.body: A landscape illustration puts scenery first; a venue sketch focuses on the building; a type-led layout gives the wording more room. You do not have to include peaks, trees, maps and a monogram on the same card. Pick the visual detail that best represents your celebration and preserve space for the event information.
bullets: Landscape focus: a single scenic drawing with simple text.
Lodge focus: an architectural illustration and a clear venue name.
Minimal focus: clean type with a restrained accent.

sections.heading: Help guests arrive at the right place
sections.body: A mountain destination can include several properties or ceremony areas with similar names. Use the actual venue and city on the invitation, then provide the confirmed address and meeting point on the details page. If transport is provided, explain where guests board and when it leaves.
bullets: Confirm the final ceremony location before printing.
Distinguish parking, shuttle pickup and ceremony arrival instructions.
Include a reception address when it differs from the ceremony site.

sections.heading: Move outdoor logistics off the main invitation
sections.body: Guests may need to know about terrain, layers, transport and a weather backup plan. These details are useful, but they should not crowd the invitation. Use confirmed information from the venue or planner and provide a wedding website where updates can be made.
bullets: Describe footwear or surface considerations in plain language.
Explain how guests will hear about any weather-related change.
List optional weekend activities separately from the wedding events.

sections.heading: Check the artwork and the print proof
sections.body: The current hand-sketched template depicts the building shown in its photos, not your mountain venue. A custom drawing or map requires a separate conversation. For any fine-line illustration, review a proof at final size and make sure the small location text survives the paper and printing process.
bullets: Confirm custom illustration scope, price and timing before purchase.
Check that the printable file meets your chosen printer’s specifications.
Keep physical cards and printing arrangements separate from the digital design.

faqs.a: The current shop does not list a dedicated alpine or forest design. Browse the existing artwork or ask about a custom illustration before buying.

faqs.q: What should mountain destination wedding invitations say?
faqs.a: Include names, date, ceremony time, venue and city. Put travel, transport, outdoor preparations and weather updates on a separate details page or wedding website.

faqs.q: Can you draw our mountain lodge for the invitation?
faqs.a: Ask about a custom venue illustration and provide a reference. Confirm whether the studio can take the project, the deliverables, revisions, price and timeline.

faqs.q: Does mountain wedding stationery include a guest map?
faqs.a: A map is not included in the current hand-sketched invitation listing. Discuss it as a separate request and verify directions before sharing it with guests.

black-and-white-weddings.title: Black and White Wedding Invitations | Minimalist Template Guide
black-and-white-weddings.description: Plan black and white wedding invitations with typography, monochrome print checks, black-tie wording and the current hand-sketched template.
black-and-white-weddings.intro: A restrained palette puts the emphasis on lettering, spacing and illustration. Choose a black-and-white invitation for its clarity as much as its style, then check the actual design and print output before ordering.
black-and-white-weddings.decision: The current hand-sketched invitation is an illustration-led starting point. Review its photos and supported editing options rather than assuming every element can be recolored.
black-and-white-weddings.caption: The current hand-sketched venue invitation, shown as a restrained illustration-led design option.

sections.heading: Let typography establish the hierarchy
sections.body: Make the couple’s names the focal point, then give the date, time and venue a consistent rhythm. One expressive font paired with a readable supporting font is often enough. Black-and-white design leaves little visual distraction, so uneven spacing and tiny wording become easier to notice.
bullets: Read the names, date and venue in that order.
Use script sparingly if letterforms are hard to distinguish.
Check line breaks with the longest actual name and address.

sections.heading: Decide between light and dark backgrounds
sections.body: Dark lettering on a light card and light lettering on a dark card can feel very different. A dark background may require different printing choices and careful checking of the edges. The digital template alone does not establish which production method your printer will use.
bullets: Ask the printer how a dark background will be reproduced.
Check thin strokes and small reversed text in a physical proof.
Keep the selected template’s supported editing options in mind.

sections.heading: Use wording that reflects the dress code
sections.body: A monochrome design does not automatically mean the event is black tie. Include a dress code only when it matches the actual plans. Put the requested attire on a details card or website if the main invitation is already full, and avoid using decorative wording where guests need a precise instruction.
bullets: Name the ceremony and reception clearly.
Keep dress-code wording consistent across cards and the website.
Use the RSVP page for meal choices or other responses.

sections.body: Matching cards can share type, spacing and a small illustration without repeating the invitation exactly. Check the listing before assuming a full suite is included. bullets: Choose the pieces guests actually need before asking for a quote.
Confirm file dimensions and printing requirements for each piece.
Check the proof for contrast, crop and readable fine detail.

minimalist-weddings.title: Minimalist Wedding Invitations | Simple Canva Template Guide
minimalist-weddings.description: Choose minimalist wedding invitations with readable typography, simple wording, a hand-sketched Canva template and practical editing and print checks.
minimalist-weddings.intro: Keep the design simple without leaving guests guessing. A minimalist invitation gives the names, date and venue room to breathe, with the practical details organized on a separate card or wedding website.

sections.heading: Decide what deserves space on the card
sections.body: Minimalist wedding invitations work through hierarchy, not just a lack of decoration. Make the couple’s names easy to find, then group the date, ceremony time and location together. If every line has a different font or size, the card can feel busier even when there is no illustration.
bullets: Use a readable supporting font for time, address and RSVP details.
Keep one consistent alignment through the main information.
Reserve decorative lettering for short text that stays legible.

sections.heading: Keep the essential wording, move the logistics
sections.body: Short wording still needs to answer who, what, when and where. An informal opening is fine if the invitation clearly names the event. Move lodging, transport, multiple weekend gatherings and longer attire notes to a details card or website rather than shrinking the type to fit them.
bullets: Include the full date and a clear ceremony time.
Name a separate reception venue when needed.
Give guests an obvious response method and deadline.

sections.body: A venue sketch can be the only decorative feature, while a typography-led design can let spacing carry the style. bullets: Check every name, date, venue and RSVP destination.
Confirm export dimensions, bleed and margins with the printer.

mid-century-modern-weddings.title: Mid-Century Modern Wedding Invitations | Retro Style Guide
mid-century-modern-weddings.description: Plan mid-century modern wedding invitations with architecture-led design, readable retro typography and the current Palm Springs save the date template.
mid-century-modern-weddings.intro: Start with clean spacing, an architectural focal point and a limited accent palette. A retro look can feel playful while still giving guests a clear date, location and next step.

bullets: Architecture-led: let one building or landscape sketch anchor the card.
Type-led: pair an expressive heading with readable supporting text.
Color-led: use a small palette and enough contrast for the practical details.

sections.heading: Distinguish the save the date from the invitation
sections.body: A save the date helps guests reserve the day and begin travel planning. An invitation gives the ceremony time, venue and response instructions. The Palm Springs template is a front-and-back save the date; it should not be treated as a ready-made full invitation suite.
bullets: Save the date: names, date, destination and website if ready.
Invitation: ceremony time, actual venue and reception information.

sections.heading: Connect the architecture to the actual wedding
sections.body: The existing Palm Springs illustration may suit a desert-modern celebration, but it is the artwork shown in the product gallery. bullets: Use the actual event city even when the style is Palm Springs-inspired.

bullets: Check tiny lettering and pale accents in the proof.
Confirm bleed and export settings with your chosen printer.
Keep template, custom design, printing and postage costs separate.

Proof your final colors and lettering on paper.

faqs.q: What gives wedding invitations a mid-century modern look?
faqs.a: A restrained layout, architecture-led artwork, expressive typography or a limited accent palette can create a retro-modern direction. Use one clear focal point and keep guest information readable.

faqs.q: Is the Palm Springs template a mid-century wedding invitation?
faqs.a: The current product is a Palm Springs save the date with an existing venue sketch. It can support an architecture-led style, but it is not a wedding invitation or a full suite.

faqs.q: Can I change the building in the Palm Springs save the date?
faqs.a: A new drawing is a separate custom request. Review the current gallery and editing guidance before buying; supported text changes do not include replacing the illustration.

faqs.q: Can I request coordinating mid-century modern wedding stationery?
faqs.a: Send the studio the design you like, the pieces you need, your event date and any illustration references. Confirm availability, scope, pricing and timing first.

vintage-weddings.title: Vintage Wedding Invitations | Classic Wording & Template Guide
vintage-weddings.description: Plan vintage wedding invitations with readable script, classic wording, venue illustration ideas and careful digital-template and print guidance.
vintage-weddings.intro: Choose a detail that carries the vintage feeling—a venue sketch, a classic type pairing or a restrained border—then let the rest of the card stay clear. A nostalgic style should still be easy for guests to read and use.
vintage-weddings.decision: The current hand-sketched invitation is an illustration-led option, not an antique reproduction or a custom portrait of your venue. Check its gallery and editing scope.
vintage-weddings.caption: Current hand-sketched venue invitation, shown as an illustration-led option for a classic stationery direction.

sections.heading: Choose the vintage detail that matters
sections.body: Vintage-inspired wedding invitations can feel formal, romantic or relaxed. Decide whether the mood comes from lettering, illustration or a border before adding more decoration. Mixing several ornate elements can make the information harder to find and may not suit the template you are editing.
bullets: For a classic direction, focus on a clear type hierarchy.
For a venue-led direction, give the drawing space around it.
For a romantic direction, use script sparingly and keep location details readable.

sections.heading: Use formal wording that fits your hosts
sections.body: Traditional wording often begins with a hosting line, but there is no reason to name hosts who are not part of your plans. Use “Together with their families” when it fits, or begin with the couple’s names. A formal tone should not obscure the date, time or whether guests are invited to a ceremony, reception or both.
bullets: Check preferred names and spellings with everyone named on the card.
Choose one consistent style for the date and time.
Use reception-only wording when that is the event guests will attend.

sections.heading: Bring a historic venue into the design honestly
sections.body: A building sketch can connect stationery to an estate, garden setting or architectural venue. The current template depicts the venue shown in its photos, not any building you name in the wording. For a different drawing, share a reference and ask the studio to confirm scope, revisions and timing.
bullets: Check the gallery to see the illustration actually included.
Treat a new venue portrait as a separate request.
Ask about matching details cards or RSVP cards before planning a suite around them.

sections.heading: Check fine lines, script and paper together
sections.body: Small flourishes and thin strokes are best judged at the finished size. Textured or warm-toned paper may change the appearance of the artwork and type, so ask your printer about a suitable file and order a proof. A digital template purchase does not include specialty printing, envelopes or a physical mailing.
bullets: Read every scripted name without enlarging the proof.
Check contrast between the ink and your chosen paper.
Verify card size, envelope fit and the assembled mailing before the full order.

vintage-weddings.wording:
Together with their families
[Name] and [Name]
request the pleasure of your company
at the celebration of their marriage
[Day, date] at [time]
[Venue name], [city]
Reception to follow
checklist: Choose one vintage design feature to lead.
Check the hosting line and preferred names.
Make scripted text readable at final size.
Confirm whether the artwork is existing or custom.
Review a proof on your chosen paper.

faqs.q: What makes a wedding invitation vintage-inspired?
faqs.a: Classic lettering, a venue illustration, a restrained border or a softer paper palette can create a vintage direction. Choose details that fit the event and keep the essential wording clear.

faqs.q: Do vintage wedding invitations need formal wording?
faqs.a: No. You can use a vintage design with conversational wording. Match the hosting line and tone to your plans while making the event, date, time and venue explicit.

faqs.q: Can I use the hand-sketched template for a historic venue wedding?
faqs.a: It may suit your style, but its drawing is the existing illustration shown in the gallery. A portrait of your specific historic venue is a separate custom request.

faqs.q: Does a vintage wedding template include specialty paper or printing?
faqs.a: The current shop products are digital designs. Paper, printing, envelopes and specialty finishes are arranged separately with your chosen printer.

palm-springs-wedding-invitations.title: Palm Springs Wedding Invitations & Save the Dates | Canva Guide
palm-springs-wedding-invitations.description: Explore the Palm Springs Canva save the date, destination wedding wording, guest details and print checks. Understand what the digital purchase includes.
palm-springs-wedding-invitations.h1: Palm Springs wedding invitations & save the dates
palm-springs-wedding-invitations.intro: Give your destination a place on the card without packing the whole weekend into the wording. Start with the current hand-drawn Palm Springs save the date, then plan the invitation and guest details as separate pieces.
palm-springs-wedding-invitations.decision: The live Palm Springs listing includes a front-and-back save the date. A wedding invitation, matching cards or new venue illustration are separate custom requests.
palm-springs-wedding-invitations.caption: Current Palm Springs save the date with the existing venue sketch. Review both sides on its product page before choosing.

sections.heading: Start with the stationery you actually need
sections.body: A save the date announces the day and destination before the full ceremony details are ready. An invitation asks guests to attend a specific event at a specific time. The current Palm Springs product is an editable save the date, so do not assume it includes an invitation, RSVP card or complete wedding suite.
bullets: Save the date: names, wedding date and actual city.
Invitation: ceremony time, venue and reception details.
Website or details card: travel information, schedule and responses.

sections.heading: Personalize the Palm Springs Canva template
sections.body: The current save the date uses a hand-drawn venue sketch with editable wording on a front-and-back design. Check the gallery for the illustration and layout, and follow the included Canva guidance. A new drawing of your hotel or ceremony site requires a separate conversation with the studio.
bullets: Edit your names, date and destination within the supported options.
Check both sides for old placeholder text before exporting.
Confirm any new illustration or coordinating piece before placing a custom order.

sections.heading: Keep destination guest information current
sections.body: Guests may be booking travel before you have finalized every weekend detail. Share confirmed information on one wedding website and label optional events clearly. Use the actual city where each event takes place rather than relying on a broad Palm Springs destination label for directions.
bullets: Verify venue addresses and any transport meeting points.
Separate welcome events, the ceremony and a farewell gathering.
Set your RSVP deadline around the dates your vendors need final numbers.

sections.heading: Plan the printing and mailing as separate steps
sections.body: The featured save the date is a 5 × 7 front-and-back design. Confirm the printer’s file, bleed and two-sided alignment requirements before exporting. Print one proof, review both sides, then choose envelopes that fit the finished card. Check postage for the assembled mailing rather than budgeting only for the digital design.
bullets: Proof names, date, location and wedding website.
Test a website link or any QR code you choose to add.
Confirm paper, envelope fit and postage separately from the template purchase.

Print a two-sided proof before the full order.

faqs.q: Is the Palm Springs wedding stationery a printed product?
faqs.a: The featured product is a digital Canva save the date. You personalize and download the design, then arrange printing separately.

faqs.q: Does the Palm Springs save the date include a wedding invitation?
faqs.a: No. The current listing covers the front-and-back save the date. Discuss any separate invitation, RSVP or details card request with the studio.

faqs.q: Can I replace the Palm Springs venue illustration?
faqs.a: The current template uses the drawing shown in its gallery. A new illustration of your particular venue is a custom request, not a standard text edit.

faqs.q: Do I need Canva Pro for the Palm Springs save the date?
faqs.a: The current product guidance says the design uses elements available on Canva’s free plan. Check the listing and avoid adding paid elements if you want to keep your edits within that plan.
